title: Safety Violation Event Data
description: CloudEvent data payload for org.governancecommons.agent-matrix.safety.violation.v1. Emitted when an agent detects or is blocked by a safety constraint.

violation_id.description: Unique identifier for this violation instance.

constraint_id.description: Identifier of the safety constraint that was violated or triggered. References safety_constraints section of the agent matrix.

agent_id.description: agent_id of the agent that detected or was subject to the violation.

detected_at.description: RFC3339 UTC timestamp when the violation was detected.

blocked.description: True if the action that triggered the violation was blocked. False if the violation was logged only.

action_attempted.description: Description of the action that was attempted and triggered the violation.

escalation_level.description: Escalation level triggered by this violation per agent-dossier escalation_protocol.
